name: Excise the Imperfect
oracle_text: Exile target nonland permanent. Its controller incubates X, where X is its mana value. (They create an Incubator token with X +1/+1 counters on it and "{2}: Transform this token." It transforms into a 0/0 Phyrexian artifact creature.)
blocked_sentences: Its controller incubates X, where X is its mana value.

needs.what: a `player` (or `controller`) option on the `incubate` op so a player other than the effect's controller incubates -- here the exiled permanent's last controller, e.g. a `snapshot` of the target's controller taken before the exile, with X read from the snapshotted mana value
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `incubate` takes only `amount` and `as` and op_incubate always creates the Incubator under ctx.controller; `create_token` has `controller` but writing `incubator_token` by hand would bypass incubate's enters-with counters, and `for_each_player` only binds a seat without changing who the op creates the token for
